findings.claim: The generated Flint evidence is host-dependent, so the Ubuntu Pages workflow can regenerate different PNG/WebP bytes and fail the mandatory clean-artifact diff.
findings.evidence: The SVG renders every text element with font-family=system-ui, whose resolved font depends on host font configuration. generate-evidence.mjs rasterizes that SVG with Sharp, while docs-pages.yml regenerates evidence on Ubuntu and requires an empty generated-artifact diff. Repeating generation on one host does not prove cross-platform parity.
findings.suggested_fix: Make the SVG self-contained by embedding a pinned font or converting text to paths, regenerate the evidence artifacts on the CI platform, and add a clean Ubuntu regeneration-parity check.
